verdict: Organic search is holding; overdue pipeline milestones are the priority now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating a combined 383 actions — 174 from Advance Grinding Services, 138 from O'Hare Precision Metals, and 71 from Forte Precision Metals — over the last 28 days. No paid spend ran on any brand, meaning all measurable activity came from organic local search. GBP engagement is softening across the board, with week-over-week declines of 27% at AGS, 64% at Forte, and 4% at O'Hare, driven by modest search impression volumes that leave the profiles with little headroom. The more pressing issue is a series of CRM, outreach, and web milestones that were due as far back as July and remain unresolved — these block the cold outreach pipeline from starting and prevent downstream contact data from flowing. Resolving those blockers is the immediate focus, and the contact list pull and stub reconciliation are being pushed to closure this period so outreach sequences can launch on schedule by end of September.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three brands in the last 28 days
week-over-week drop in GBP engagement at Forte Precision Metals, the sharpest decline across the group
paid leads generated this period — no paid campaigns are active on any brand

watch_item.issue: Two Google Business Profile listings — Precision Ground Metals and Precision Ground Bars — recorded zero calls despite consistent impressions over 28 days, indicating a broken or missing call path on both profiles.
watch_item.fix: The call button setup on both profiles is being reviewed and corrected this week so inbound call activity is captured going forward.
